data: Stone et al. 2022, VizieR J/MNRAS/514/164/table1: 190 quasars, 570 band light curves (g, r, i), z = 0.20-4.15

variants.label: MacLeod relations (λ^0.17, M^0.21, none in L)
wavelength + black-hole mass, fitted within redshift bins
wavelength + luminosity, fitted within redshift bins
wavelength + mass + luminosity, within redshift bins

notes: two-stage fits: stage 1 with 8 equal-count redshift bins as fixed effects gives covariate slopes; stage 2 regresses the corrected log tau on log(1+z). Weighted least squares with intrinsic scatter by maximum likelihood; errors = mean of the published asymmetric errors; bootstrap over quasars (seed 11; fixed-relation runs seed 3).
